facts.fact: Adwave's published channel threshold lists TV, Google (YouTube, Demand Gen and Search), Facebook, Instagram, mobile web and apps as channels that can become eligible from a $30 per day budget.
facts.quote: From $30/day | TV, Google (YouTube, Demand Gen and Search), Facebook, Instagram, mobile web and apps

facts.fact: Adwave's published channel threshold adds Reddit at a daily budget of about $35.
Adwave's pricing page planning example uses a $75 per day budget, which across 30 active days comes to $2,250 with no monthly subscription.
facts.quote: across 30 active days that comes to $2,250, with no monthly subscription

facts.fact: Per Adwave, a channel threshold is a minimum budget rather than a guarantee, and budget, creative, campaign settings and content eligibility decide what can run.
facts.quote: budget, creative and campaign settings, together with content eligibility, decide what can run

facts.fact: Per Adwave, campaigns pause if the prepaid wallet runs dry, and advertisers can pause before 30 active days.
facts.quote: You can pause before 30 days, and campaigns pause if the prepaid wallet runs dry.

facts.fact: The article states that it compares multichannel and omnichannel advertising on six criteria.
facts.quote: We compared multichannel and omnichannel as strategies on the same six criteria.

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing page (October 2026) says agency licenses start at $499 a month, with media billed at cost.
facts.quote: agency licenses start at $499 a month, with media billed at cost.

facts.fact: Adwave says agency creative generation can be drawn from the wallet as a paid charge that is separate from the license and from media.
facts.quote: Agency creative generation can draw from the wallet as a paid charge, separate from the license and from media

facts.fact: Adwave says its single prepaid budget covers all four connection points from an earlier test for paid media (audience, creative, budget and reporting).
facts.quote: which covers all four connection points from the earlier test for paid media

facts.fact: Adwave states it is built for paid advertising and does not run email or CRM, and does not manage in-store or customer-service channels.
facts.quote: Adwave is built for paid advertising. It does not run email or CRM, and it doesn’t manage in-store or customer-service channels.
